samples.question: Two distant corner strokes are drawn (dark indigo) on a white canvas, one in the upper-left area and one in the lower-right area. Each stroke points in one of the four directions: right, down-right diagonal, down, or down-left diagonal. The two strokes either share the SAME direction (reading as two continuing parallel rails) or diverge at a RIGHT ANGLE to each other. Do the two distant strokes point in the same direction?
